contexts.text: He is to thee a covering of the eyes, unto all that are with thee () = that rational truths are as a covering or clothing to spiritual truths. Explained.
The exterior things of the Word are a covering or clothing.
The coverings, or veils and coverings, of the tabernacle = the exterior celestial and spiritual things in the three Heavens. Fully Explained.
Relatively to truth, what is scientific is called a covering and a garment.

His covering in the blood of grapes () = that His Intellectual is the Divine good from His Divine love... Covering = the Intellectual; for it is a recipient, and that which receives, being a vessel, is like a covering. See AC 3300:2. AE 475:12.
(The distinction between vestment and covering.) Explained.
The covering on Moses' face () = the external of the law. Explained. AC 10600. AC 10701. AC 10701:end. AC 10702:2. AC 10706.
He removed the covering until he came out () = a state of enlightenment then. Explained.

Each degree is distinguished from the others by its own coverings; and all the degrees by a general covering; and the general covering communicates with the interior and inmost things in their order. Hence the conjunction and unanimous action of all things. DLW 195. DLW 278.
The natural degree, being the ultimate one, is as it were the general covering of the two higher degrees.
Above the Sensuous (of atheists) appears as it wore a covering... CL 415. CL 421.
Meanwhile, there is as it were a covering interposed (between Heaven and man).
In the male, the inmost is love, and its covering is wisdom... But in the female, the inmost is that wisdom of the male, and its covering is love thence derived.
To them the things of Heaven are as coverings...
The seed there clothes itself with a natural covering.
Some cast a black covering over his face...
